本条是 **2026-11-11 团队日工作簿**：23 项待办 + 负责人，要求各人向 `@workerantbot` 报进展，本质是 **分工与催收**，不是新一轮口径评审。

对又初而言，当日主责在工作簿里已点名：**设备标签、归因升级、指标库、渠道推广周/月汇总 + 管理报表三表、海豚未迁移（归因看板/渠道/页面 14 张）** 等，与设备渠道收尾无直接替代关系，需 **双线推进、别混排期**。

`[LESSON: dws_device_channel_sdk_* | 日表须有探针并挂在 g_device_daily 末尾；送审前在生产 verify 跑完整业务日并按 app（×渠道）对账。]`

-- task: dws_register_attribution_result_d_paimon_shadow · 补正式表 6 列
-- doc: 影子 SR 表缺 score_brand/model/system/system_version/score_time/time_bucket_max_seconds；列位对齐正式表
-- bus: #13228
-- env: 先 test 再 prod；ALTER 前 DESC 核对影子仍为 29 列
-- 正式表列序: score 后接 5 个 score_*；time_diff_seconds 后接 time_bucket_max_seconds

ALTER TABLE dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d_paimon_shadow
  ADD COLUMN score_brand INT NULL COMMENT '品牌项实际加分(计算当时)' AFTER score,
  ADD COLUMN score_model INT NULL COMMENT '型号项实际加分(计算当时)' AFTER score_brand,
  ADD COLUMN score_system INT NULL COMMENT '系统名项实际加分(计算当时)' AFTER score_model,
  ADD COLUMN score_system_version INT NULL COMMENT '系统版本项实际加分(计算当时)' AFTER score_system,
  ADD COLUMN score_time INT NULL COMMENT '时间衰减项实际加分(计算当时)' AFTER score_system_version,
  ADD COLUMN time_bucket_max_seconds INT NULL COMMENT '命中时间档max_seconds' AFTER time_diff_seconds;

-- task: attr_rewrite_status
-- doc: snap_v2 之后按海豚 dim_user_attribution_channel_apply_d 规则派生 rewrite_status/reason；切正式时退役海豚 apply
-- params: dt
-- 用法: run_spark_sql_sr.sh attr_rewrite_status.sql attr_rewrite_status [SMALL] dt=YYYY-MM-DD
--
-- 依赖（须在 dws_user_snapshot_d_d_v2 之后）:
--   paimon.dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d   当日归因结果（含 score_* 表尾 6 列）
--   paimon.dws.dws_user_snapshot_d_d_v2            当日快照（已含归因覆盖后的 channel）
--   paimon.dim.dim_app_attribution_config_snap    当天 snap_dt 配置
-- 写出: INSERT OVERWRITE 同日 result 分区；其它列透传，只改 rewrite_status / rewrite_reason
-- 列序: 与 ddl_attr_result_paimon.sql / attr_result.sql 一致（6 分项列在表尾）
-- bus: #13228

INSERT OVERWRITE ${OUT_DB}.dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d
SELECT
    r.dt,
    r.app_id,
    r.uid,
    r.register_event_id,
    r.register_event_time,
    r.attributed_channel,
    r.source_event_id,
    r.source_event_type,
    r.source_event_time,
    r.score,
    r.score_threshold,
    r.confidence_level,
    r.attribution_status,
    r.unattributed_reason,
    r.time_diff_seconds,
    r.reg_ip,
    r.reg_brand,
    r.reg_model,
    r.reg_system,
    r.reg_system_version,
    r.hit_ip,
    r.hit_brand,
    r.hit_model,
    r.hit_system,
    r.hit_system_version,
    r.rule_version,
    r.created_at,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(c.is_rewrite_channel, 0) = 0 THEN CAST(NULL AS TINYINT)
        WHEN r.attribution_status <> 'success' THEN CAST(NULL AS TINYINT)
        WHEN r.attributed_channel IS NULL OR TRIM(r.attributed_channel) = ''
             OR LOWER(TRIM(r.attributed_channel)) = 'organic' THEN CAST(NULL AS TINYINT)
        WHEN s.channel IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.channel) <> ''
             AND LOWER(TRIM(s.channel)) NOT IN ('organic', 'natural', 'self', 'unknown')
             AND s.channel <> r.attributed_channel THEN CAST(NULL AS TINYINT)
        WHEN s.channel = r.attributed_channel THEN CAST(1 AS TINYINT)
        ELSE CAST(0 AS TINYINT)
    END AS rewrite_status,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(c.is_rewrite_channel, 0) = 0 THEN '未回写-app未灰度'
        WHEN r.attribution_status = 'unattributed'
             AND r.unattributed_reason = 'no_candidate' THEN '未回写-无候选'
        WHEN r.attribution_status = 'unattributed'
             AND r.unattributed_reason = 'score_below_threshold' THEN '未回写-低置信'
        WHEN r.attribution_status <> 'success' THEN COALESCE(r.rewrite_reason, 'organic-待归因')
        WHEN r.attributed_channel IS NULL OR TRIM(r.attributed_channel) = ''
             OR LOWER(TRIM(r.attributed_channel)) = 'organic' THEN '未回写-归因仍organic'
        WHEN s.channel IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.channel) <> ''
             AND LOWER(TRIM(s.channel)) NOT IN ('organic', 'natural', 'self', 'unknown')
             AND s.channel <> r.attributed_channel
            THEN COALESCE(r.rewrite_reason, '已有真实渠道-免归因')
        WHEN s.channel = r.attributed_channel
            THEN CONCAT('已回写-命中', r.attributed_channel)
        ELSE '未回写-渠道未变更'
    END AS rewrite_reason,
    r.score_brand,
    r.score_model,
    r.score_system,
    r.score_system_version,
    r.score_time,
    r.time_bucket_max_seconds
FROM paimon.dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d r
LEFT JOIN paimon.dim.dim_app_attribution_config_snap c
    ON r.app_id = c.app_id
   AND c.snap_dt = '${dt}'
LEFT JOIN paimon.dws.dws_user_snapshot_d_d_v2 s
    ON s.dt = DATE'${dt}'
   AND s.app_id = r.app_id
   AND s.uid = r.uid
WHERE r.dt = DATE'${dt}';
